survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is a corrigendum that only updates an author affiliation and does not report any empirical analysis, sampling procedure, or weighting strategy. Because no PISA microdata, scaling, or plausible-value estimation is described here, there is no basis to specify whether student or replicate weights (e.g., TOTWGT/W_FSTUWT and BRR/JRR) were applied. The original article (referenced in the corrigendum) would need to be consulted to determine the complex survey design handling and any weight variables used in estimation. As provided, the corrigendum contains no information about preprocessing, missing-data handling, or model training that would allow a weighting assessment.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: Plausible values and missing-data handling are not applicable to this corrigendum because it does not present any empirical modeling, outcome construction, or estimation procedure. The text only corrects an author affiliation from the originally published article and does not describe dependent variables, PV-based achievement scores, or any imputation/deletion strategy. Therefore, there is no methodological basis to report PV or missing-data handling for this document itself.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: No analytic sample is defined in this corrigendum. The document does not describe any dataset extraction, country selection, grade/domain restriction, or inclusion/exclusion criteria; it only states that the affiliation of Minju Hong was incorrectly listed in the originally published article.
